clue.text: Right-hand, in tender part of palm

indicators.note: the letter for right-hand is placed inside the word for tender

parts.note: tender as in affectionate, fond
R is the standard abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Someone's right hand rests in the soft, sensitive part of their palm.
explanation.definitionFit: A palm tree's leaf is a frond, so the clue's 'palm' is the tree, not the hand.

clue.text: Thick celebrity philosophical type

parts.note: thick in the sense of stout or plump
an A-list person is a top celebrity

explanation.surface: A dim-witted star poses as a deep thinker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Thick' suggests stupid, but here it means plump.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who believes events are fixed by fate holds a philosophical outlook of resignation.

clue.text: Pusher of uncut rock, say

indicators.note: say signals that the word for rock is heard spoken, giving a different spelling

parts.note: ore is unprocessed rock from which metal is extracted

explanation.surface: Something that shoves raw stone along, perhaps.
explanation.definitionFit: A rower's blade pushes against the water to drive the boat forward.

clue.text: Widow's money risked after swindle

indicators.note: the bet comes after the swindle in the answer

parts.note: to do someone is to cheat them
a wager is a sum staked on an outcome

explanation.surface: A widow's savings are gambled after she is conned.
explanation.definitionFit: A widow who holds a title or property from her late husband is called by this name.

clue.text: Nuts out of box — they may contain chemicals

indicators.note: signals a letter coming out of the word for nuts while the box goes in its place

parts.note: nuts is slang for testes
the box, like the tube, is slang for television

explanation.surface: Someone takes nuts out of a box, while a lab note follows.
explanation.walkthrough: The E of TESTES that is swapped out is not separately clued; TUBE takes its place.
explanation.definitionFit: Laboratory glass cylinders hold samples and reagents during experiments.

clue.text: Belief in aliens going back and forth from Neptune originally

indicators.note: the planet's first letter is put in the middle of the aliens' letters

parts.note: ET, the film alien, read back (TE) and then forth (ET)

indicators.note: takes the first letter of the planet's name
takes the first letter of the planet's name

explanation.surface: Faith in aliens shuttling to and from Neptune.
explanation.walkthrough: The extraterrestrial abbreviation is read both ways, giving a word that is the same backwards; 'from ... originally' supplies the centre.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctrine or principle someone holds to is a creed or belief.

clue.text: Different pusher with same rock as 2 turned up — a comic character

indicators.note: a different arrangement of the word pusher
in a down light, turned up means read from the bottom

parts.note: 2 down's wordplay used ore, unprocessed rock

explanation.surface: Another pusher, rolling the same stone as before, shows up in a comic strip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Different' rearranges PUSHER into SUPERH; 'turned up' reverses ORE to ERO.
explanation.definitionFit: A caped crusader such as Superman is a stock comic-book figure.

clue.text: Nailed tenor solo by Domingo originally

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for tenor in music
doing something solo is doing it alone

indicators.note: the first letter of the singer's name

explanation.surface: Placido Domingo, the great tenor, nailed his solo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nailed' looks like praise for a performance, but means having nails, as claws.
explanation.definitionFit: Having claws on the feet, as a bird of prey does, is having nails.

clue.text: Funds and free entertainments announced for poorer part of town

parts.note: to fund is to back financially

indicators.note: announced signals that the word is spoken, giving a word of similar sound

parts.note: a treat is something enjoyed at another's expense

explanation.surface: Funding and free shows are promised for the town's deprived area.
explanation.definitionFit: Side streets away from the main roads are associated with the shabbier quarters of a town.

clue.text: Divers remove moisture outdoors

definitions.meaning: divers, an old word for various or assorted
to dry something by leaving it in the sunshine

explanation.surface: Divers towel off outside.
explanation.definitionFit: Assorted or miscellaneous things are various; and drying in the open air uses the sun.

clue.text: Unpaid extra in set piece

definitions.meaning: something added free with a purchase
in football, the restart from the touchline is a planned set play

explanation.surface: A free bonus included as part of a set.
explanation.definitionFit: A freebie added to a deal is tossed in; in soccer a restart from the sideline is a set play.

clue.text: Lithium in nut is good for bird

indicators.note: the symbol for the element goes inside the nut

parts.note: a pecan is a nut
Li is the chemical symbol for lithium

explanation.surface: Lithium within a nut turns out to be good for a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A large waterbird with a throat pouch for holding fish.

clue.text: Drunk single reptilian lawyer

parts.note: lit is slang for drunk
I is the Roman numeral one
a gator, short for alligator, is a reptile

explanation.surface: A boozy, unmarried lawyer with a cold-blooded nature.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who brings or conducts lawsuits is a legal professional who goes to court.

clue.text: Crumbling hostel with inept operator

indicators.note: crumbling breaks the words up so their letters can be rearranged

explanation.surface: A rundown hostel with a hopeless switchboard worker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crumbling' rearranges the letters of HOSTEL and INEPT together.
explanation.definitionFit: A switchboard operator connects calls, which is the job of this worker.

clue.text: Punch busybody

definitions.meaning: someone who pokes their nose into others' business

explanation.surface: Hit the meddler.
explanation.definitionFit: A blow on the nose is one sense; a nosy, prying person is the other.

clue.text: NASA corralled into schedule based on earth's orbit

indicators.note: made into: the letters of the two words are turned into something new

explanation.surface: NASA rounded up into a timetable tied to the planet's path around the sun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' rearranges the letters of NASA CORRALLED.
explanation.definitionFit: A dating system tied to the year the planet takes to circle the sun, like the Gregorian one.

clue.text: Hates, but also kind inside at the same time

indicators.note: the word for kind goes within the word for simultaneously

parts.note: as, meaning while or just when
a version is a kind or variant

explanation.surface: Someone loathes things yet is kind-hearted all at once.
explanation.definitionFit: Strong dislikes are the plural noun matching hates in its noun sense.

clue.text: Boss with debt receipts effectively possessing industry

parts.note: a boss is a stud, a raised knob
an IOU is a written acknowledgement of debt

explanation.surface: A boss whose IOUs effectively give him control of an industry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boss' suggests an employer; it is a decorative knob. 'Industry' means diligence, not a business sector.
explanation.definitionFit: Industry here is hard work, so someone diligent and given to study has it.

clue.text: Order black percolated coffee, the brief psychological remedy

parts.note: to order things is to place them
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

indicators.note: percolated coffee is filtered and stirred about, so the letters are mixed
brief cuts the word short to its first letter

explanation.surface: Ordering black filter coffee, the quick pick-me-up that works on the mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'percolated' rearranges COFFEE to OEFFEC; 'brief' cuts THE to T.
explanation.definitionFit: Improvement brought about by a patient's belief in a dummy treatment is a remedy working on the mind.

clue.text: Number of area measurements in cage are inaccurate

indicators.note: inaccurate letters are wrong in order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Measurements of an enclosure's area are wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inaccurate' rearranges the letters of CAGE ARE.
explanation.definitionFit: Land extent measured in acres is a count of area units.

clue.text: Before battle, take up weapon from what's near to hand?

definitions.meaning: to equip with arms in advance of a fight
the part of the arm right next to the hand

explanation.surface: Arm yourself before the fight with whatever is handy.
explanation.definitionFit: To prepare with weapons in advance is one sense; the lower arm, between elbow and wrist, adjoins the hand.

clue.text: City sector unevenly bordered with cut grass

indicators.note: the picked letters are surrounded by the word for cutting grass

parts.note: to mow is to cut grass

indicators.note: unevenly takes the odd-numbered letters

explanation.surface: A city district edged with ragged, freshly mown grass.
explanation.definitionFit: The Russian capital is a major city.

clue.text: Poetic exclamation on grim smell

parts.note: O, as in 'O for a muse of fire', is the poet's cry
dour means stern or gloomy

explanation.surface: A poet's cry about a dreadful stink.
explanation.definitionFit: A scent or whiff is a smell, often an unpleasant one.

clue.text: Jimmy with mute exterior when hit for six

indicators.note: the word for mute is on the outside, around the word for jimmy

parts.note: a surd is a voiceless consonant in phonetics, and surd means mute
to jimmy a lock is to prise it open

explanation.surface: Jimmy, silent on the outside, after being knocked out of the ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hit for six' is British slang from cricket for being stunned, as by a ball struck over the boundary.
explanation.definitionFit: To be hit for six is to be utterly taken aback or astonished.

clue.text: Treacherous in spirits, thus beheaded

indicators.note: the first letter is cut off

parts.note: in high spirits, lively and playful

explanation.surface: Drink-sodden and therefore decapitated, a dangerous business.
explanation.definitionFit: Treacherous ground is hazardous and full of danger.

clue.text: City's fashionable past

parts.note: chic means stylish
ago means in the past

explanation.surface: A city's stylish history.
explanation.definitionFit: The Windy City on Lake Michigan is a big American city.

clue.text: A politician blocking leave for cleaner

indicators.note: the politician stands within the word, blocking the way out

parts.note: shoo! is a command to leave
MP, Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A politician stops someone leaving in order to keep things clean.
explanation.definitionFit: A hair-washing liquid is a cleaning product.

clue.text: Mostly weak joke

indicators.note: mostly drops the last letter

parts.note: puny means feeble or weak

explanation.surface: A rather feeble gag.
explanation.definitionFit: Wordplay on double meanings is a type of joke.

clue.text: Act ultimately through craftiness and cunning, or through opposite qualities?

indicators.note: the last letter goes through the middle of the word for craftiness

parts.note: wiles are crafty tricks

indicators.note: ultimately takes the final letter

parts.note: sly means cunning

explanation.surface: Behave by craft and guile, or by their reverse?
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on the clue: acting through the opposite of craftiness and cunning is acting foolishly.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting without wits is acting stupidly, the reverse of crafty cunning.

clue.text: Sign regularly found in addition's reverse?

definitions.text: Sign regularly found in addition's reverse?
definitions.note: subtraction, the opposite of addition, uses this symbol in every sum

indicators.note: the picked letters are placed inside the reversed total
the word for addition is read backwards

parts.note: a sum is an addition

indicators.note: takes every other letter, here the second and fourth

explanation.surface: A symbol you routinely meet when doing the opposite of adding up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes IN from Sign; 'reverse' turns SUM to MUS; the whole clue also describes the subtraction sign.
explanation.definitionFit: The subtraction symbol is the counterpart of plus, so it stands for the opposite of adding.
